sql.value: SELECT t.*, COALESCE(temp.sr, 0) sr, COALESCE(temp.zc, 0) zc, COALESCE(temp.srbs, 0) srbs, COALESCE(temp.zcbs, 0) zcbs, coalesce(t.initialBalance, 0) + coalesce(temp.sr, 0) - coalesce(temp.zc, 0) balance FROM (SELECT ffca.id, ffca.CODE, ffca.`name`, ffca.type, COALESCE( COALESCE((SELECT ffcj2.balance FROM fxy_financial_cashier_journal ffcj2 WHERE ffcj2.account_id = ffca.id AND ffcj2.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId AND ffcj2.bill_date < :start ORDER BY ffcj2.bill_date DESC, ffcj2.serial DESC, ffcj2.serial_number DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT ffcj2.balance FROM fxy_financial_cashier_journal ffcj2 WHERE ffcj2.account_id = ffca.id AND ffcj2.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId AND ffcj2.init = 1 LIMIT 1)), 0 ) AS initialBalance FROM fxy_financial_cashier_account ffca WHERE ffca.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT ffca.id AS aid, sum(ffcj.debit) sr, sum(ffcj.credit) zc, sum(IF(ffcj.debit IS NULL, 0, 1)) srbs, sum(IF(ffcj.credit IS NULL, 0, 1)) zcbs FROM fxy_financial_cashier_account ffca LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_cashier_journal ffcj ON ffcj.account_id = ffca.id AND ffca.account_sets_id = ffcj.account_sets_id WHERE ffcj.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffcj.bill_date between :start and :end GROUP BY ffcj.account_id, ffca.type) AS temp ON t.id = temp.aid

select temp.*, temp.initBalance + temp.sr - temp.zc as balance from (select ffca.id, ffca.code, ffca.account_sets_id, ffca.name, ffc.name currencyName, ffca.currency_id, ffca.subject_id, ffs.code as subject_code, sum(coalesce(ffcj.debit, 0)) sr, sum(coalesce(ffcj.credit, 0)) zc, coalesce((select ffcj2.balance from fxy_financial_cashier_journal ffcj2 where ffcj2.account_id = ffca.id and ffcj2.account_sets_id = ffca.account_sets_id and ffcj2.bill_date < :start order by ffcj2.bill_date DESC, ffcj2.serial DESC, ffcj2.serial_number DESC limit 1), (select ffcj2.balance from fxy_financial_cashier_journal ffcj2 where ffcj2.account_id = ffcj.account_id and ffcj2.account_sets_id = ffca.account_sets_id and ffcj2.init = 1 limit 1)) as initBalance from fxy_financial_cashier_journal ffcj left join fxy_financial_cashier_account ffca on ffcj.account_id = ffca.id and ffca.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId left join fxy_financial_currency ffc on ffca.currency_id = ffc.id and ffc.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId left join fxy_financial_subject ffs on ffca.subject_id = ffs.id and ffs.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId where ffcj.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffcj.bill_date between :start and :end and ffca.subject_id is not null #[and ffca.id = :cashierAccountId] #[and ffca.currency_id = :currencyId] group by ffca.subject_id, ffca.id, ffca.code, ffca.account_sets_id, ffca.name, ffc.name, ffca.currency_id, ffca.subject_id, ffs.code) as temp

select ffvd.begin_balance balance from fxy_financial_balance ffvd where ffvd.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffvd.auxiliary_detail_id = 0 and ffvd.subject_id = :subjectId and ffvd.currency_id = :currencyId and ffvd.year = :year and ffvd.period = :period

select sum(coalesce(ffvd.debit_amount, 0)) sr, sum(coalesce(ffvd.credit_amount, 0)) zc from fxy_financial_voucher_details ffvd left join fxy_financial_voucher ffv on ffvd.voucher_id = ffv.id and ffv.account_sets_id = ffvd.account_sets_id where ffvd.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffvd.subject_id = :subjectId and ffv.voucher_date between :start and :end group by ffvd.account_sets_id, ffvd.account_sets_id

select ffcit.id, ffcit.code, ffcit.name, ffcit.type, coalesce(sum(ffcj.debit), 0) sr, coalesce(sum(ffcj.credit), 0) zc, sum(IF(ffcj.debit is null, 0, 1)) srbs, sum(IF(ffcj.credit is null, 0, 1)) zcbs from fxy_financial_cashier_journal ffcj left join fxy_financial_cashier_io_type ffcit on ffcj.io_type_id = ffcit.id and ffcj.account_sets_id = ffcit.account_sets_id where ffcj.account_sets_id = :accountSetsId and ffcj.bill_date between :start and :end and ffcj.io_type_id is not null group by ffcit.type, ffcit.name, ffcit.code order by cast(ffcit.code as signed)
